rows.label: Title
rows.tooltip: The title of the photo.

rows.label: Description
rows.tooltip: A description of the photo. May contain some limited HTML.

rows.label: Tags
rows.tooltip: A space-seperated list of tags to apply to the photo.

rows.label: Is Public
rows.tooltip: Set to 0 for no, 1 for yes. Specifies who can view the photo.

rows.label: Is Friend
rows.tooltip: Set to 0 for no, 1 for yes. Specifies who can view the photo.

rows.label: Is Family
rows.tooltip: Set to 0 for no, 1 for yes. Specifies who can view the photo.

rows.label: Safety Level
rows.tooltip: Set to 1 for Safe, 2 for Moderate, or 3 for Restricted.

rows.label: Content Type
rows.tooltip: Set to 1 for Photo, 2 for Screenshot, or 3 for Other.

rows.label: Hidden
rows.tooltip: Set to 1 to keep the photo in global search results, 2 to hide from public searches.

rows.label: Name
rows.tooltip: Shown in the list as: Name - Server:Port

rows.label: Protocol
rows.tooltip: Connection protocol

rows.label: Host
rows.tooltip: Host, e.g. google.com

rows.label: Port
rows.tooltip: Port number

rows.label: Is Active
rows.tooltip: Set true for active or false for passive

rows.label: Sub Folder Path
rows.tooltip:
FTP sub folder path, example: Screenshots.
You can use name parsing: %y = year, %mo = month.

rows.label: Browser Protocol
rows.tooltip: Choose an appropriate protocol to be accessed by the browser

rows.label: Http Home Path
rows.tooltip:
URL = HttpHomePath + SubFolderPath + FileName
If HttpHomePath is empty then URL = Host + SubFolderPath + FileName
%host = Host

rows.label: Http Home Path Auto Add Sub Folder Path
rows.tooltip: Automatically add sub folder path to end of http home path

rows.label: Http Home Path No Extension
rows.tooltip: Don't add file extension to URL

rows.label: FTPS Encryption
rows.tooltip: Type of SSL to use. Explicit is TLS, Implicit is SSL.

rows.label: FTPS Certificate Location
rows.tooltip: Certificate file location. Optional setting.

rows.label: Keypath
rows.tooltip: Key location

rows.label: Passphrase
rows.tooltip: OpenSSH key passphrase

rows.label: Name
rows.tooltip: Shown in the list as: Name - LocalhostRoot:Port

rows.label: Localhost Root
rows.tooltip: Root folder, e.g. C:\Inetpub\wwwroot

rows.label: Port
rows.tooltip: Port Number

rows.label: Sub Folder Path
rows.tooltip: Localhost Sub-folder Path, e.g. screenshots, %y = year, %mo = month. SubFolderPath will be automatically appended to HttpHomePath if HttpHomePath does not start with @

rows.label: Http Home Path
rows.tooltip:
HTTP Home Path, %host = Host e.g. google.com without http:// because you choose that in Remote Protocol.
URL = HttpHomePath + SubFolderPath + FileName
URL = Host + SubFolderPath + FileName (if HttpHomePath is empty)

rows.label: Http Home Path Auto Add Sub Folder Path
rows.tooltip: Automatically add sub folder path to end of http home path

rows.label: Http Home Path No Extension
rows.tooltip: Don't add file extension to URL

rows.label: Remote Protocol
rows.tooltip: Choose an appropriate protocol to be accessed by the browser. Use 'file' for Shared Folders. RemoteProtocol will always be 'file' if HTTP Home Path is empty.
